sysarch.introduction: Two components: a hot redirect path and a colder link-administration path.

techspec.runtime: Elixir/OTP, one BEAM node per environment.
techspec.write-path: Link creation writes synchronously; click counts increment inline on redirect.
techspec.concurrency: One process per request; no shared mutable state beyond the database.
techspec.deploy: Single managed instance, autodeploy on merge to main.

component.name: Redirector
component.purpose: Resolve a short code to its target and record the click.

owned-invariants.invariant: A short code, once minted, never resolves to a different target.
A redirect is recorded even when the target is unreachable.

primary-operations.operation: Resolve a short code to its target URL.
Record a click against a short code.
Report 404 for an unknown or retired code.

component.name: LinkAdmin
component.purpose: Validate targets, mint short codes, and let owners retire links.

owned-invariants.invariant: No two live links share a short code.
Retiring a link is immediate, not soft-deleted.

primary-operations.operation: Mint a new short code for a validated target.

policy.name: Immutable short codes
policy.rationale: A stable link is the entire value proposition - reassigning a code silently breaks every place it was ever shared.
